help.title: Help and safety
help.notRescueTitle: NamWatch is not a rescue service
help.notRescueBody: We do not send rescue teams. If you need help, call one of the numbers above.
help.safetyElectric: Keep away from lamp posts, junction boxes and any cable sitting in water. If your home floods, switch off the breaker first.
help.safetyWade: Do not wade through fast-moving water or water where you cannot see the ground. Open drain covers are a common hazard.
help.safetyDrive: Water above half a wheel can stall a car and float it. Turning back beats pushing through.
help.safetyWater: Floodwater is usually contaminated. Wash hands and any cuts, and do not drink water that has not been boiled.
help.traffyTitle: Asking the city to fix it
help.traffyBody: Traffy Fondue is the BMA channel that puts your report into the official work queue.
help.sheltersBody: Follow BMA and DDPM announcements for the current list of shelters.

about.title: About NamWatch
about.whatBody: NamWatch combines official water-level data with reports from people on the ground, so the flood picture sits in one place.
about.notOfficialBody: NamWatch is a volunteer project, not a BMA or DDPM service. For official guidance, follow the agencies' own announcements.
about.privacyBody: There are no accounts. We do not collect names or phone numbers. Home and help reports are blurred to an approximate area before publication.
about.privacyRetention: We keep hashes of device and IP identifiers purely to limit spam, and delete them within 7 days.
about.pdpa: Handled in line with Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act.

consent.title: Cookies and analytics
consent.body: We would like to collect anonymous usage statistics to improve the app. We never send your location, your notes, or any device identifier.
